spec: poll-matrix-engine-spec.md (2026-09-22, owner-approved; supersedes Readme.txt as build brief)
note: Every value here is copied into predictions.json's engine block on each run so published numbers are always traceable to the exact parameters that produced them.
grades_note: Keys are source_name values as they appear in snapshot sources / docs/polls.json rows. Transcribed result images ARE the widget's final numbers (grade A, transcription risk carried in provenance). FB-group manual rows = B. ngnews247 rank-only titles = C (constraint rows only, never shares).

constraint_rules.note: Full cap/floor when the constraint's ordering agrees with the aggregated shares; halfway pull toward the bound on conflict. Every application (soft or full) is logged with before/after shares.

carry_forward.note: Actives not covered by any full-share source this week inherit last week's aggregated share before renormalisation. Never fabricated poll numbers; the carry is explicit and flagged.

gambit.rule: housemates with an active gambit period in week N never enter the matrix
gambit.dashboard: auto-finalists strip (no share, no win number)
